question: What is the meaning of energy consumption in different use phases in relation to sustainability features?
data_point: energy consumption in different use phases
description: Energy consumption in different use phases in relation to sustainability features refers to the amount of energy utilized during the construction, operation, and end-of-life stages of a building. This measurement is crucial for assessing the environmental impact and sustainability of a building throughout its lifecycle. By monitoring and optimizing energy consumption at each phase, it is possible to enhance the overall sustainability performance of the building, reduce carbon emissions, and promote resource efficiency.
